title: dalbergia mollis var. menabeensis
intro: Dalbergia mollis var. menabeensis, commonly known as the Menabe rosewood or Madagascar rosewood, is a plant species within the Fabaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its numerous health benefits. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Dalbergia mollis var. menabeensis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
